 Peer into that crystal ball and here’s what we think will happen this week!
 blitzsportsga 
 November 19, 2026 
 Welcome to our ‘In the Bag’ Crystal Ball Weekly Predictions, brought to you by Bagwell Insurance – Matt Adams . We have been good on over 80% through 20 years, and in the regular season we finished right at 84%, and were 90% on the first round of the playoffs! Below are the Round Two matchups and predictions for what we think will happen.

 Game of the Week – Jefferson vs Benedictine (Installed by Rabun Flooring) – BLITZ 
 November 20, 2026 at 6:43 am 
 […] We typically make a case for both, with our official pick linked below. Let’s begin with the Dragons. To win this game, they simply cannot turn the ball over like they did last Friday night. This Benedictine team is too talented offensively. Jefferson will need to jump out to a quick start and hang the hat on that defense, as it always does. The Cadets will need a big night from their 3-star running back, Stanley Smart. Benedictine needs to put the pressure on from the start by getting points, and not settling for field goals. Watch out for this game to be decided by third and fourth-down stops. OFFICIAL PICK […]
